description: This is a false-colour satellite image depicting Oro-Iberian Festuca indigesta grasslands at an altitude above 2,000 metres in the Madrid region of the Spanish Central Mountains range. The image shows a mountainous landscape with varied land cover. Areas of dense vegetation appear in shades of deep red, while sparser vegetation, grasslands, or rocky terrain are depicted in greenish-cyan and light brown tones. A single, distinct bright green circular marker is centrally located on a vegetated slope in the upper-middle portion of the image. The image is credited to M. Palacios.
